s: Large Language Models like Claude operate on a stateless, 'fire-and-forget' paradigm, akin to old CGI-bin scripts, where each interaction is a fresh instantiation with the entire conversation history re-submitted, rather than maintaining persistent server-side state like ASP.NET.
sub: LLM statelessness and conversational continuity illusion
Immutable base models vs. real-time online learning (River)
Pragmatic engineering trade-offs in LLM deployment
